text:
The spiders
iban for the laurels.
The casualidad
itself goes tornando in snow,
and the años dormidos
already itself atreven
to clavar the telares
of the siempre.


The quietud hecha esfinge
itself laughs of the Death
that sings melancólica
in a grupo
of lejanos cypresses.


The yedra of the gotas
tapiza the walls
empapadas of arcaicos
misereres.


¡Oh tower old! Cries
your tears mudéjares
over this grave courtyard
that no has fountain.


The spiders
iban for the laurels.

translation.title: Courtyard húmedo
